hooks.command:
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in *.lua) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; stylua "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; err=$(luajit -bl "$f" /dev/null 2>&1) || { printf 'Lua syntax error in %s:
%s
' "$f" "$err" >&2; exit 2; }; out=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" && selene "$(basename "$f")" 2>&1) || { printf 'selene findings in %s:
%s
' "$f" "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
